🔥 भाईजान की फिल्म के ट्रेलर पर छिड़ा बवाल, क्या सच में मेकर्स ने सब कुछ दिखा दिया?

सलमान खान ने अपनी आने वाली फिल्म Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace के ट्रेलर की आलोचना पर खुलकर जवाब दिया है!
ABP India इवेंट के दौरान सलमान ने उन सोशल मीडिया यूजर्स को जवाब दिया जिनका कहना था कि लगभग पांच मिनट का ट्रेलर बहुत लंबा है और इसने पूरी कहानी बता दी है।
सलमान ने इस बात को खारिज कर दिया और दर्शकों से अपील की कि वे 4 दिसंबर को फिल्म थिएटर्स में रिलीज होने तक अपना जजमेंट रोक कर रखें।
सलमान ने अपने अंदाज में कहा कि ट्रेलर लंबा नहीं है और उन्होंने दर्शकों से कहा कि Never judge a book by its cover, क्योंकि लोगों ने कवर से ही बुक को जज कर लिया है।
उन्होंने उन लोगों पर भी मजाकिया अंदाज में तंज कसा जिन्होंने सीन्स को एनालाइज करने के लिए ट्रेलर को बार-बार देखा।
अपूरर्वा लाखिया द्वारा निर्देशित यह वॉर ड्रामा फिल्म 4 दिसंबर 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज हो रही है, जिसमें सलमान खान और चित्रांगदा सिंह पहली बार साथ नजर आएंगे।
🎬 क्या आपने भी ट्रेलर को बार-बार देखकर कहानी का अंदाजा लगाने की कोशिश की है?

ctx.text:
The actor addressed complaints about the trailer’s runtime and claims that it revealed too much of the storyline, asking audiences to wait until the film’s December 4 release.
Salman Khan has responded to the criticism surrounding the trailer of his upcoming film Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace . During a promotional interaction at an ABP India event, the actor addressed social media users who felt that the nearly five-minute trailer was too long and had revealed much of the film’s storyline. Dismissing the suggestion that the promotional video had given away the entire narrative, Khan urged viewers to reserve their judgement until they watch the film in theatres.
Since the trailer was released earlier this month, its runtime and the amount of story it appeared to reveal have become talking points among a section of social media users. Responding to the comments with his trademark humour, Salman said that the complete film would be available for audiences to watch on December 4.
Addressing the criticism, he said, “Trailer bahut lamba hai.. poori picture dikha di. Nahi Bhai, Poori picture main aapko dikhaunga December 4 ko. Kya bolte hai – Never judge a book by its cover. Aapne cover se hi book ko judge kar liya. Ab jab yeh ulta padega tabhi kya hoga (The trailer is too long... they have shown the entire film. No brother, I will show you the entire film on December 4. What do they say – Never judge a book by its cover. You have already judged the book by its cover itself. Now, what will happen when this backfires)?”
The actor also took a playful dig at those who had repeatedly watched the trailer to analyse its scenes and identify details about the plot. Suggesting that the full-length film would give them considerably more to discuss, he added, “Aapko paanch minute ke trailer mein, itne baar dekh ke, itne saare points nikaalne pade, ab dhai ghante ke film mein kitne baar dekhoge picture aap (In a five-minute trailer, after watching it so many times, you had to pick out so many points; now in a two-and-a-half-hour film, how many times will you watch the movie)...”
A post shared by Bollywood Hungama🎥 (@realbollywoodhungama)
Directed by Apoorva Lakhia, Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace is a war drama featuring Salman Khan and Chitrangda Singh together for the first time. Produced under the banner of Salman Khan Films, the film is scheduled for a nationwide theatrical release on December 4, 2026.
